prompt: What enhancement occurs under Texas law if a first-time DWI driver tests with a BAC of 0.15 or higher?

options.text: The offense is automatically dismissed if the driver completes inpatient detox
The offense carries mandatory revocation of vehicle title ownership documents
The offense escalates to a Class A misdemeanor with fines up to $4,000 and 1 yr jail
The driver is barred permanently from obtaining any Texas commercial employment
